mapper.sql: select n.id, n.receiver_user_id, n.actor_user_id, n.notice_type, n.target_type, n.target_id, n.title, n.content, n.action_url, n.status, n.read_time, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time, n.remark, ru.user_name as receiver_user_name, ru.nick_name as receiver_nick_name, au.user_name as actor_user_name, au.nick_name as actor_nick_name from vol_notification n left join sys_user ru on ru.user_id = n.receiver_user_id left join sys_user au on au.user_id = n.actor_user_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from vol_notification where receiver_user_id = #{receiverUserId} and status = 0
mapper.update: update vol_notification set status = 1, read_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and receiver_user_id = #{receiverUserId} and status = 0
